description: This Java class 'ContentServicesComplex' provides static service methods for retrieving content and content association data, including methods for fetching associated content views and data resources with filtering options based on dates, types, and other criteria. It is part of the Apache OFBiz framework, specifically within the content management module.

classes.name: ContentServicesComplex
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for content association and data resource retrieval within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResource
methods.description: Service method to retrieve associated content and data resources based on various filtering parameters.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResourceMethod
methods.description: Internal method to query content associations and related data resources with filtering by dates, types, and direction.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResourceCache
methods.description: Cached version of the service to retrieve associated content and data resources with additional string-based type filtering.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResourceCacheMethod
methods.description: Internal method to perform cached retrieval of content associations and related data resources with complex filtering.
